title: FERC Delegated Order — Docket CP26-41-000: Letter to National Fuel Gas Supply Corporation approving the 08/11/2026 request to convert approximately 0.04 acres of temporary workspace to permanent right-of-way under CP26-41.
text:
FEDERAL ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION
WASHINGTON, D.C. 20426
OFFICE OF ENERGY PROJECTS
In Reply To:
OEP/DG2E/Gas 3
National Fuel Gas Supply
Corporation
Docket No. CP26-41-000
§375.308(x)
VIA Electronic Mail
September 1, 2026
Ms. Meghan M. Emes
Senior Counsel
National Fuel Gas Supply Corporation
mendelm@natfuel.com
Re: Approval of Alternative Measure Under the Blanket Certificate Program
Dear Ms. Emes:
I approve National Fuel Gas Supply Corporation’s (National Fuel’s) request
dated August 11, 2026, to convert approximately 0.04 acres of temporary workspace
to permanent right-of-way. To accommodate fencing installation within the current
compressor station limits. The permanent right-of-way would be located in Erie
County, New York.
Use of this alternative measure is consistent with Section I.A and IV.A.1 of the
Commission’s Upland Erosion Control, Revegetation, and Maintenance Plan. The
conversion from temporary to permanent would only impact already disturbed lands.
We agree with National Fuel that this change is necessary because a portion of
this Plan is infeasible or unworkable based on project-specific conditions.
Additionally, we have confirmed that use of the additional temporary workspace will
not result in additional effects on sensitive environmental resource areas, including
threatened and endangered species and known historic properties, forested lands, and
that National fuel has landowner approval for the requested change.

I remind you that National Fuel must comply with all the standards set forth
in the Commission’s Upland Erosion Control, Revegetation, and Maintenance Plan.
If you have any questions regarding this approval, please contact Harry Jeudy at
(202) 502-8539.
Sincerely,
Eric Tomasi
Environmental Engineer
